paragraphs: Mentioned in Sheviit, chapter 2, halakhah 5: R' Assi said that R' Lazar gave a ruling to R' Shabbetai de-Tzadoki.[^1][^2]

notes.text: שובתי/Shovti and שבתי/Shabbetai remain different supplied spellings with the same designation דצדוקי. That designation is not admitted as a sectarian identity.

לעזר is retained as Lazar rather than silently expanded. הורה means gave a ruling/instructed; Assi reports Lazar ruling for Shabbetai. פ״ב ה״ה gives chapter 2 halakhah 5, suggesting Jerusalem Talmud format without an explicit corpus or independently checked edition. All four personal title components remain R'.
